environment.description: Same Ktor microservice on ECS Fargate in a private subnet. S3 access is routed exclusively through a Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with an endpoint policy that restricts requests using condition keys: aws:PrincipalOrgID must match o-abc123def4, s3:prefix must start with 'configs/', and the bucket ARN must match arn:aws:s3:::alpha-data-prod or arn:aws:s3:::beta-data-prod. Additionally, the subnet route table has no NAT Gateway route for S3 prefixes (pl-63a5400a), forcing all S3 traffic through the VPC endpoint. The ECS task role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:policy/DocumentServiceBoundary) that denies s3:* unless aws:SourceVpce equals vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890. The ALB target group has a deregistration delay of 300s with health check interval 5s, unhealthy threshold 2 - meaning after 2 consecutive 500 responses (10s), the target is deregistered and traffic shifts to the healthy instance.

config.network: Private subnet, internal ALB, no NAT route for S3 prefix list
